_comment: music_bot_role_id = dedicated '🎵 Music Bot' role assigned to the music bot user; managed by MusicBot/scripts/setup_music_role.py. By default the music bot logs into the existing 'future_bots' channel under the 🤖━ سجلات البوتات ━ category. After deploy, MusicBot/scripts/setup_channels.py creates dedicated #🎵music-play / #🎵music-errors / #🎵music-admin channels and updates these IDs.
